t: Grokking the Codebase: Chisel Strikes, Cultural Threads, and Future-Proofing Workflow
s: This article explores the intersection of cultural concepts like 'grokking' and 'vanity cards' with practical software architecture, detailing a 'chisel-strike' approach to code organization and future-proofing workflows in the Age of AI.
sub: Analysis of 'grokking' origins and philosophical implications, contrasting Heinlein's concept with Manson Family appropriation.
Discussion of 70s/80s TV production logos (vanity cards) as cultural touchstones.
Demonstration of iterative code refactoring for improved workflow ergonomics and modularity ('chisel-strikes').
Architectural distinction between user-managed project files and core framework tools for better system design.
